title: Foul Potion
description:
Deal [blue]12[/blue] damage to ALL players and enemies.
Can be thrown at the [gold]Merchant[/gold] for [blue]100[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] instead.
notes: Foul Potion has dual functionality: in combat, it deals 12 damage to all enemies. Outside of combat in a merchant room or Fake Merchant event, it can be thrown at the merchant to gain 100 Gold instead.
